title: Activist priest slams arrests of anti-Trump, Pax Silica protesters

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Activist Catholic priest Fr. Warren Puno has condemned the series of arrests of protesters opposing the anticipated visit of United States President Donald Trump for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and the Pax Silica initiative. “We strongly condemn any excessive and unjustified use of force against peaceful protesters.
